stories.title: Follow live: Falcons answer as Bijan Robinson runs in for TD
White Sox clinch AL playoff berth after 324 losses over previous 3 seasons
stories.summary: The White Sox became the first team to follow consecutive 100-loss seasons by reaching the playoffs, clinching at least an AL Wild Card berth with win No. 82 this year.

stories.title: 49ers' Juszczyk baffled by NFL fine for imitating 'chugging a beer'
stories.summary: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 on Thursday for "engaging in offensive demonstrations."

stories.title: Alford to retire after final season with Nevada
stories.summary: Steve Alford is ending a 36-year coaching career that also included stops at Iowa, New Mexico and UCLA.

stories.title: Pelinka: LeBron's Lakers exit 'done amicably'
stories.summary: Rob Pelinka said Thursday that the Lakers remain thankful for their time with LeBron James.
